Ethmoiditis is an infection or inflammation of the ethmoidal cells in the sinuses. These are the air-filled spaces behind the nose and between the eyes. Ethmoiditis is a type of sinusitis . Causes Bacteria cause most ethmoid sinus infections. Some types of fungus and viruses can also be involved. Symptoms Symptoms usually include: Headache between the eyes Runny nose Nasal congestion Loss of sense of smell Symptoms of more serious infections can include: Vision loss Double vision Redness or bulging of the eyes Images Sinuses References Benninger MS, Roxbury CR, Stokken JK.
